item.title: Version 3.2.2
item.description:
Fixes

  • Fixed a crash and possible hang when deleting gates and merging zero-length wire segments (#110, #120).
  • Fixed the Windows updater crash at startup caused by a missing callback (#111).
  • Removed the obsolete XML pre-scan from normal v3 file loading. Opening v3 files no longer sends their contents through the legacy XML parser (#117, #118, #122).
  • Hardened cross-platform crash reporting so fatal POSIX signals write a minimal report and defer stack dumping to the operating system.

Refactors

  • Consolidated wire segment topology, drag handling, collision refresh, and joining logic into focused components.
  • Removed duplicated wire-drag and joining paths.
  • Added coverage for wire topology, segment dragging, collision handling, parser safety, and crash-report issue formatting.
